blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — More Filipinos are turning to modern family planning methods, but concerns about weight gain, depression, infertility, sexual problems and cancer continue to shape how women decide whether to start or stop using hormonal contraception. Data from the Philippine Statistics Authority’s 2025 National Demographic and Health Survey (NDHS), as cited by the Commission on Population and Development (CPD), show that 58.6% of married women use some form of family planning, while 33.8% of all women do so.
